component.name: Cooler
component.summary: Choose the face on your cooler's screen and how fast its pump and fans run

description.p: Cooler looks after a liquid cooler that has a screen. Choose the face the screen shows, from a calm liquid level to a clock or a ring of colour, and set its brightness and which way up it sits.

Pick how the pump and fans behave, Quiet, Balanced or Performance, or drag the points of your own curve, and watch the temperatures and speeds as they change. Cooler works with NZXT Kraken coolers that have a screen. Settings are kept on this PC and nothing is sent anywhere: no accounts and no tracking.
